authorities.Define: Candidate session, Pack preparation, fidelity and readiness only
authorities.shared_Lab: Context, owner-review routing, real native permission/commit, canonical publication and source transition
authorities.owner: Actual semantic disposition and separately scoped publication authorization

ordered_steps: Observe expected registry/index/source selection and native HEAD with original-byte bindings; verify current role assignments and target scope.

Prepare immutable candidate publication bundle: exact bodies, reconstructed projections, mixed-version registry, indexes, lineage, semantic dispositions and expected predecessor. JSON Schema alone is insufficient.
Obtain actual exact-bundle publication authorization separately from semantic review and native effect permission. Any changed bytes or HEAD require re-evaluation and new scoped authorization.
Submit native operation using its real op ID, proposal, permission and expected HEAD. Record actual local receipt; unknown outcomes require read-only reconciliation of original operation.

After verified local commit, stage qualified immutable repository/source snapshot and independently verify all referenced bytes and consumers. LocalCommittedAwaitingPublication remains visible on failure.

Publish through a selected single current-source pointer CAS against the expected predecessor. This requires a real implemented source publisher and reader-adoption protocol, not multiple ordinary file writes.
Verify observed selected snapshot/postimage and publication receipt, then perform separately governed source-profile transition. Preserve old cuts and receipts.
atomicity: No distributed atomicity across native store and repository. No claim that multi-file working-tree writes are atomic. Proposed immutable snapshot plus one qualified selection CAS; legacy direct-path readers must be fenced or migrated before qualification. Git commit/push alone is not admission.

recovery.native_unknown: Inspect original op/HEAD before any retry; never mint a new op merely because response was lost
recovery.publication_unknown: Read selected snapshot and original publication op; preserve committed receipt if observed
recovery.cas_conflict: Do not merge or re-sign automatically; compute new postimage, re-review and re-authorize
recovery.partial_commit: Keep immutable local receipt and explicit pending publication state; do not report Complete
